intent: Connector ingestion parses single and batched Notion / Readwise API payloads into typed domain models without panic or silent drops.
user_story: As a user syncing Notion / Readwise, when the connector pulls a page or article payload from the vendor API, every entity I have read-access to must appear in the local model — including single-page responses (cursor tests), multi-page responses (pagination), and empty pages (deletion / filter).

steps.then: It returns exactly one NotionPage with title, id, icon, timestamps and url populated

steps.given: A Notion task-shaped JSON object with Completed + Due properties
steps.then: It returns one NotionTask with completed + due_date populated

steps.given: A Notion results:[] batch of two pages
steps.then: It returns two NotionPage objects (no silent drops)
It returns an empty list, not a panic
It returns one Article with id, title, author, source_url, cover_image_url, published_date, created_at, updated_at populated
It returns one Highlight with text, note, document_id, color, created_at, updated_at populated

steps.given: A Readwise results:[] batch of two articles
steps.then: It returns two Article objects (no silent drops)
It returns an empty list, not a panic
